# Cncf Orkestrix Reviewer

Review ORKESTRIX using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. ORKESTRIX is a full-stack Kubernetes distribution by QUANTUM C&amp;S, automating infrastructure provisioning, including QKS(Quantum Kubernetes Service) and various back-office components, tailored to each customer&#39;s environment.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
